source: V2 A7 terminal audit a86e3f7 (1 MEDIUM + 3 LOW + 2 INFO) + V2 accepted-findings record; carried into V3 as binding lessons

lessons.lesson: stress-tier cost multipliers were never applied to booked stress PnL in V2 (tier1.5 duplicated base; tier2.0 delay-only at base costs)
lessons.v3_action: MANDATORY: P1 accounting regression implements stress-tier multipliers applied to booked stress PnL with a hand-computed fixture proving tier 1.5 and tier 2.0 differ from base; regression-pinned BEFORE any proposal selection

lessons.lesson: stress tier semantics conflated cost stress with fill-delay stress (tier2.0 expectancy delta +1.7564 was re-timing, not cost)
lessons.v3_action: stress arms must separate cost-tier multipliers from delay stress and record both; report tier deltas per component

lessons.lesson: self-reported UTC stamps in control artifacts led machine-verifiable UTC by ~1 hour
lessons.v3_action: all V3 control artifacts stamp from machine `date -u` at write time with stamp_source recorded; never future-date

lessons.lesson: ledger rows carried static published:false because the publisher never flipped the flag
lessons.v3_action: V3 publisher must flip the published flag in the ledger row it writes; A7 checks the flag at terminal

lessons.lesson: narrative file counts can drift from operative manifests (173 vs 174)
lessons.v3_action: counts quoted in any artifact must be recomputed from the operative manifest, not from narrative

lessons.lesson: 'decisions' counts decision points including voids, not executed trades
lessons.v3_action: keep this definition explicit in every schedule/feasibility artifact
